## Workflow 03 — Baseline Diagnosis (error capture)

**Captures baseline metrics from 01e error executions.**

This workflow handles only the Error Trigger path. Success metrics are captured inline within the 01e scanner workflow itself (added Code + Airtable nodes at the end of 01e).

**Flow:**
1. Error Trigger catches 01e failures
2. Parse error execution data for per-node item counts
3. Read Profile for snapshot
4. Record error baseline metrics to Airtable

**Per D-09:** Does NOT record if zero results or errors occurred.
**Modifies no workflow files.**
